messages:
Iris Park: Sharing a new dense-tile mock for latency rows: big p95 primary, compact throughput (RPS) sparkline underneath, and a small 'Sampling' chip in the top-right. Chip opens an inline popover with Mode + % slider. Quick ask: keyboard flows and copy please. :wave:
Noah Bennett: Nice and compact. Two requests: 1) chip should always show state (e.g., 'Sampling: Adaptive' or 'Sampling: 10%'), 2) throughput needs the unit 'RPS' visible. Also add small hover tooltip on sparkline with exact RPS.
Aria Gupta: Accessibility checklist: chip must be focusable by keyboard and include aria-expanded + aria-controls. Popover should be role="dialog" since it contains sliders, and we should announce open with a polite live region: "Sampling settings opened. Currently Adaptive at 10%". When the slider updates, push polite live region updates with new percentage.
Leo Wang: UX nit: on very narrow columns collapse the throughput to an icon-only affordance; mobile shows p95 only. For the popover, hide any "est. cost" line behind an opt-in toggle to avoid alarming users.
Iris Park: Microcopy suggestions: chip text "Sampling: Adaptive" (capital A). Popover title "Sampling settings". Help link text "What is sampling?" linking to docs. If we show cost, prefix with 'Estimated' and add clarifier 'For rendered traces only; not a billing statement.'
Noah Bennett: Keyboard shortcut: press 't' to open time range picker; inside the picker left/right moves by small delta, Shift+left/right jumps larger intervals. Add these to the keyboard shortcuts page.
Aria Gupta: Implementation snippet for devs to follow: <button aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sampling-pop" aria-label="Open sampling settings: currently Adaptive">Sampling: Adaptive</button> and a div with role="dialog" id="sampling-pop" aria-labelledby="sampling-title". Also ensure visible focus ring on the chip.
DesignBot: auto-lint: contrast-warning for chip microcopy at current token color; recommend using text-strong token or heavier weight. Tag: design-accessibility. :robot_face:
Iris Park: Thanks all 1 I'll update the figma with chip state, aria snippet, opt-in cost toggle, and mobile collapse behavior and post link when ready. :raised_hands:
